sources.title: OLSK Large CNC V3 / original V2-named assembly models
limitations: The upstream V3 README and CAD coexist with V2-named original GLB files; their filenames and geometry are preserved, not relabelled as a verified V3 runtime twin.

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 original assembly
limitations: StealthBurner is maintained as a separate upstream project. This view preserves the exact assembly shipped in the pinned Voron-2 CAD, without substituting a different toolhead.
原 STEP 的第 8935 面是依赖原顶点/边容差闭合的极薄曲面，其精确面积无法认证。该唯一固定来源面保留原 OpenCascade 生成的 4 个三角形，并按原文件自身精度单独审计；没有投影替换、补封边或删除该面，不计入普通闭合面 0.5% 面积核验。详见 source-precision-audit.json 与转换报告的 nativeToleranceLimitedFaces。

sources.title: Jubilee V2.2.2 original assembly
limitations: Original CAD and tool-changing structure are displayed. Python hardware control is retained for separate research and is not executed by the browser.

sources.title: Science Jubilee original tools and control code
OPC UA teaching conveyor / feeding mechanism
limitations: The upstream code drives timed PWM sequences and exposes a timestamp; it does not provide measured position feedback.
The upstream arm documentation disagrees on its axis count. The original structure is preserved without claiming a verified six-axis cobot.
The source tree contains no complete BOM or the PDF drawings claimed by its README. Hardware control and host shutdown scripts are not run by this integration.
